name: sjdb_church
description: A modern full-stack Catholic parish management platform for St. John de Britto’s Church, Kalayarkoil. It connects parishioners, priests, and administrators through online Mass intentions, certificate requests, events, daily liturgical readings, Holy Rosary, parish records, notifications, WhatsApp automation, analytics, and secure account management

paragraphs: A modern, full-stack Catholic Parish Management and Community Web Application built for St. John de Britto Church. The system connects parishioners, priests, and administrators with online Mass intention bookings, certificate requests, daily liturgical readings, Saint of the Day calendar, interactive Holy Rosary audio prayer, WhatsApp broadcast automation, event registrations, and parishioner record management.
features: Daily Mass Readings & Liturgical Calendar: Automated daily Tamil & English Mass readings synced at midnight IST, liturgical color badges, and reflection prayers.
Daily Bible Verse Rotation: Automated 12:00 AM daily verse rotation with categorization (Faith, Hope, Love, Strength, Peace) and custom administrator overrides.
Saint of the Day & Ticker: Dynamic saint calendar with feast day details, biography, prayer, and patronages.
Interactive Holy Rosary Audio Player: Complete audio recitations with Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful, and Glorious mysteries in Tamil & English with synchronized prayers.
Event Registrations & Reporting: Browse church feasts, retreats, and festivals. Parishioners can register online; administrators can export attendee rosters to customized PDF and CSV formats.
